# Third-party source records

This directory stores license and provenance records for external material adapted into the PPT Master package.

| Directory | Upstream | Runtime status |
|---|---|---|
| `humanizer/` | `blader/humanizer` | Selected concepts adapted into `references/copy-naturalness.md` |
| `taste-skill/` | `Leonxlnx/taste-skill` | Evaluated and pinned; no runtime Taste adapter is active in Phase 1 |

These records do not authorize runtime network fetching. Local behavior is defined only by the checked-in PPT Master files.
